notes.body:
# Most Wanted

Exit Only now has a police pursuit through a rainy night city.

- Police that chase, cut you off and search where you might be
- A helicopter that hunts with a searchlight
- PIT maneuvers, roadblocks and five wanted levels

The parking-deck game is still here as Rooftop Rush.
